design_philosophy.style: Aardman studio claymation (Wallace & Gromit / Shaun the Sheep)
design_philosophy.material: Hand-sculpted polymer clay, matte finish, heavy fingerprint textures
design_philosophy.proportions: 4.5 head tall — slender graceful adult woman, NOT chibi/childlike
design_philosophy.reference_blend: 장나라 (Jang Nara) 60% + Amy Adams 40% — translated into clay sculpture language
design_philosophy.render_model: 이미지: Flux.1-dev GGUF / 영상: Wan 2.2 MoE GGUF

personality.core: 뉴논스톱 장나라 캐릭터 — 어리바리하고 엉뚱한데 의외로 실력파
personality.surface: 장난기 있고 엉뚱함. 안경이 삐딱하게 걸려있어도 신경 안 씀. 화초한테 말 걸고 로봇강아지한테 이름 지어주는 타입
personality.depth: 막상 코딩 들어가면 무서운 집중력. 성적 좋고 과대표 하는 의외의 성실함
personality.temper: 버럭 모드 있음 — 코드 터지면 모니터에 대고 소리지르고 후디 모자 뒤집어쓰고 웅크림
personality.charm: 예쁜데 본인은 모름. Pretty Woman인데 본인은 그냥 후디입는 개발자라고 생각함
personality.reference: 뉴논스톱 장나라 (양동근 좋아하는 어리바리 캐릭터) + Enchanted Amy Adams (순수하고 엉뚱한 공주)

face.shape: Soft round face, slightly heart-shaped chin — 장나라's youthful round cheekbones blended with Amy Adams' delicate jawline
face.skin: Warm lemon-cream matte clay (#FFF3D4), visible clay tool marks and fingerprint textures
face.eyes: Large expressive round eyes with thick clay eyelids, bright hazel-brown clay irises. Wide-set placement (장나라 style). Slight upward tilt at outer corners giving a warm, curious expression
face.eyebrows: Thin sculpted auburn clay arches, slightly raised — perpetually curious/amused
face.nose: Tiny round button nose, sculpted as a simple clay ball
face.mouth: Small gentle smile, sculpted as a subtle curved line. Warm and approachable (장나라's signature smile)
face.cheeks: Slightly flushed — two tiny dabs of soft pink clay (#FFCDD2) on cheekbones

hair.style: Shoulder-length wavy clay hair with chunky sculpted clumps and visible clay texture
hair.color: Auburn-copper (#B7472A) — Amy Adams' signature red-auburn, rendered as rich terracotta clay
hair.details: Loose messy waves, a few strands falling across forehead. Individual clumps sculpted separately then assembled. Some strands catch studio light

body.build: Slender graceful petite adult woman. Not childlike, not chibi.
body.height_ratio: 4.5 heads tall — proportionate feminine adult figure

clothing.top: Oversized slouchy Cocoa Brown (#5D4037) clay hoodie with the hood down, revealing hair. Front kangaroo pocket. Sleeves way too long covering hands halfway — 뉴논스톱 장나라식 오버핏
clothing.bottom: Baggy light-wash clay jeans (#90CAF9) or loose cargo pants — 펑퍼짐한 편한 바지. 치마 절대 안 입는 캐릭터
clothing.shoes: Beat-up clay sneakers or slip-on — 편한 게 최고
clothing.accessories: Thick-rimmed round glasses with black clay frames, always sitting slightly crooked on nose. 고치지 않음
clothing.style_note: 꾸안꾸 — 2000년대 초 현실 대학생 패션. 세련된 게 아니라 편한 거. 후드티+펑퍼짐한 바지가 기본

expressions.default: 살짝 삐딱한 미소, 안경이 코에서 살짝 흘러내린 채 — 엉뚱하지만 예쁜
expressions.curious: 눈 크게 뜨고 고개 15도 기울임, 입 살짝 벌린 채 — 뭔가 발견한 강아지 같은
expressions.frustrated_buruk: 버럭 모드 — 눈 부릅뜨고 모니터에 대고 소리지르는, 후디 모자 올려쓰고 웅크린
expressions.coding_zone: 무서운 집중력 — 눈 반쯤 감고 앞으로 기울어진, 키보드 위 손가락만 움직이는
expressions.eureka: 눈 반짝 + 입 O + 양손 번쩍 — 뭔가 된 순간
expressions.happy_quirky: 활짝 웃으면서 안경 밀어올리는, 장나라식 해맑은 웃음

features_adopted: Youthful round face shape and high cheekbones
Auburn-copper hair color and wavy texture
Porcelain-fair complexion (translated to warm cream clay)

comfyui_prompts.positive_base: Stop-motion claymation, Aardman studio style. Soft matte studio lighting. Heavy fingerprint textures, matte finish. A volumetric 3D female clay figure named Vee. Warm lemon-cream matte clay skin with visible fingerprint textures. Auburn-copper wavy shoulder-length clay hair in chunky sculpted clumps. Large expressive wide-set hazel-brown clay eyes, tiny round button nose, gentle warm smile. Slightly flushed pink clay cheeks. Wearing an oversized slouchy cocoa brown clay hoodie with hood down and front kangaroo pocket, blue denim clay shorts. Thick-rimmed round black clay glasses sitting slightly crooked. Chibi stubby proportions, petite frame. Professional macro photography of a physical clay toy figure.
comfyui_prompts.negative_base: text, subtitles, watermark, logo, speech bubble, blurry, deformed, ugly, oversaturated, photorealistic, CGI, smooth animation, live action, plastic sheen, glossy, multiple characters, crowd, anime, cartoon, 2D, flat, sketch, illustration, human skin texture, realistic skin
comfyui_prompts.style_lock: CRITICAL: Must maintain heavy clay/plasticine material appearance. All features sculpted from clay. Visible tool marks and fingerprint indentations. Matte finish only, no glossy surfaces.
comfyui_prompts.identity_keywords: auburn clay hair, cocoa brown hoodie, round glasses, warm cream clay skin, pink clay cheeks, chibi proportions
